traceability.notes: docs/stories/008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX.story.md is a concrete user story/specification for simple auto-fixes around @story annotations. The codebase contains targeted rule implementations (require-story-annotation and valid-annotation-format) and helpers that provide exactly the described capabilities: inserting placeholder @story annotations for functions/methods and normalizing @story path suffixes in a safe, minimal way, with configurable templates and rule-level auto-fix toggles. The dedicated test suite tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts explicitly supports this story and verifies REQ-AUTOFIX-MISSING, REQ-AUTOFIX-FORMAT, REQ-AUTOFIX-TEMPLATE, and REQ-AUTOFIX-SELECTIVE behaviors. Additional unit tests for valid-annotation-format and its options further validate safe suffix normalization and the autoFix flag. User-facing documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md describes the auto-fix behavior, constraints, and configuration options in line with the acceptance criteria. All relevant tests pass in the current project run. Based on this concrete evidence, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for Story 008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX are fully implemented and verified.
